subject.title: feat(loop): implement autonomous agent loop (/loop) with token budget guard

question: Should OpenClaw add a second core `/loop` orchestration control plane alongside `/goal` and Task Flow, despite the current VISION.md guardrail?
rationale: The branch cannot be repaired mechanically until maintainers decide whether this user-facing command and orchestration model belongs in core, should extend existing goal/Task Flow seams, or should remain optional plugin workflow policy.

options.title: Reuse Existing Surfaces
options.body: Decline the parallel core loop and reshape the useful UX around `/goal`, Task Flow, subagents, and an optional plugin workflow.

options.title: Sponsor Core Loop
options.body: Explicitly approve a new core command, then require a redesign around canonical SQLite state, real usage accounting, cancellation, restart recovery, and shared runtime ownership.

options.title: Pause The Proposal
options.body: Close the PR and linked feature issue until a narrower missing API or product requirement is demonstrated against current main.

recommendation.title: Reuse Existing Surfaces
recommendation.body: Decline the parallel core loop and reshape the useful UX around `/goal`, Task Flow, subagents, and an optional plugin workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to repository scope and adjacent orchestration decisions.
